Name: BetterCrabPots
Author: WizVicky
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#00BFFF]Better Crab Pots: Fish & Roe[/color][/b][/size]
   [size=4][i]Overhaul your Crab Pots! Catch regular fish and stackable roe, auto-bait, auto-harvest into chests or Mini-
 Shipping Bins, and customize catch qualities via GMCM.[/i][/size][/center]


[size=5][b][color=#FFD700]Key Features[/color][/b][/size]

   * [b]Smart Auto-Harvest & Auto-Bait:[/b] Auto-deposit catches into chests, [b]Mini-Shipping Bins[/b] (auto-sell!), or an
[b]Overflow Chest[/b]. Link chests in-game using [b]Shift + Right Click[/b].
   * [b]QoL & Rewards:[/b] Earn 5 Fishing XP per auto-harvested pot, receive morning summary notifications, and enjoy unique
 perks from [b]Special Baits[/b] and [b]1.6 Fishing Mastery[/b] (Double Roe & Mystery Boxes).
   * [b]Quality & Foraging:[/b] Configurable Iridium/Gold/Silver chances for fish, ocean foraging (Pearls/Shells), and
 optional Legendary Fish encounters. 

              
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#32CD32]Latest Update Log (v1.0.3)[/color][/b][/size]

    * [b]Mod Renamed:[/b] Officially changed mod name from [b]"Custom Crab Pot"[/b] to [b]"Better Crab Pots: Fish & Roe"[/b].
   * [b]Co-op / Multi-Save Fix (Untested):[/b] Reworked chest linking and day updates to be per-save and host-handled to fix
 Co-op issues (Currently untested in live multiplayer).
   * [b]Mixed Mode & Drop Rate Fix:[/b] Fixed Roe not dropping in Mixed mode and added a [b]Roe Chance (%)[/b] slider.
   * [b]Roe Stacking & Color Fix:[/b] Roe is now fully stackable with vanilla roe (standard 0-star quality & matching colors).
   * [b]Smart Chests & Shortcuts:[/b] Added [b]Shift + Click[/b] in-game chest selection, Mini-Shipping Bin support, and
 Overflow chest routing.
   * [b]1.6 Mastery & Special Baits:[/b] Added Fishing Mastery perks, Mystery Box catches, and special bait effects.
   * [b]Performance & Clean UI:[/b] Switched to a zero-lag local counter overlay and streamlined the settings menu.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#FF8C00]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
   * [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API (4.0.0+)[/url]
   * [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] (Optional)

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#00BFFF]Feedback & Bug Reports[/color][/b][/size]
[i]Found a bug or have a suggestion? Please feel free to let me know in the [b]Posts[/b] or [b]Bugs[/b] tab! Your feedback
 is always appreciated.[/i]
